proposal_prompt: These images are mel spectrograms: time runs left to right, frequency runs low to high, and brighter color means more energy. Every image comes from a bird recording. Box every visible compact tonal, contoured, or vertical bird song or call, even if faint. Exclude wind, rain, microphone handling, broad full-height clicks, insects, and diffuse background noise. Prefer broad phrase-level boxes: combine nearby syllables and use at most 8 boxes per Picture. Use an empty array only when no bird-like structure is visible. Coordinates must be integers on a 0-1000 scale in [left, top, right, bottom] order, where top is high frequency. Return one JSON property per Picture, keyed by its one-based Picture number; each value is an array of boxes.
review_prompt: Review an existing bird-vocalization box proposal on the original full 10-second mel spectrogram. Preserve broad phrase-level grouping: combine nearby syllables rather than fragmenting a phrase, and use at most 8 boxes. A gap under about 0.75 seconds normally belongs inside one phrase box unless there is strong contrary evidence. Do not divide a continuous train merely to make edges tighter. On every review scan the entire original from left edge to right edge for missed faint songs, false positives, loose edges, and accidental truncation at the box limit. Bias toward retaining faint bird-like tonal or contoured structure. Coordinates are integers on the original full image's 0-1000 scale in [left, top, right, bottom] order, where top is high frequency. An optional zoom, filter, or measurement is available only to challenge an empty initial proposal. Preview the complete corrected box set three times on the full original image. Final submission must exactly match the third preview. Every operation includes a concise public decision note, not private chain-of-thought. Never use placeholders.
